articles.title: ‘AI-pilled’ firms spend $7,500 per employee each month on AI
articles.summary: The most AI-obsessed firms are spending roughly $7,500 monthly per employee on AI, per Ramp AI Index. That's not more than an engineer's salary — yet.

articles.title: How memory tools can make AI models worse

articles.title: Cybersecurity researchers aren’t happy about the guardrails on Anthropic’s Fable

articles.title: Datadog veterans launch AI coding startup Niteshift on a bet against Big AI lock-in
articles.summary: AI coding agent startup Niteshift has raised a $7 million seed round from a who's who of angels. It's betting companies will want power over, not lock-in with model makers.

articles.title: The three hard-tech moonshots fueling SpaceX’s unbelievable IPO

articles.title: It’s not FAANG anymore. It’s MANGOS.

articles.title: New York hits 5.6 GW hourly solar generation record

articles.summary: Three-quarters of organizations say they aren’t fully overseeing the activities of user accounts belonging to agents and other AI tools.

articles.title: FERC approves PJM fast-track review for ‘shovel-ready’ power projects
articles.summary: PJM will consider up to 10 interconnection requests annually over two years for resources of at least 250 MW that can come online in three years.

articles.title: In PJM, power developers are ready to build but need data center contracts, transmission
articles.summary: Over 55 GW of generation has cleared PJM’s interconnection queue process and 220 GW just entered its latest review cycle, writes Glen Thomas, president of the PJM Power Providers Group.

articles.title: DOE reinstates $57M American Battery grant
articles.summary: American Battery Technology Co. won its appeal after the agency canceled the grant last year. It will continue plans to build a $115 million commercial-scale lithium refinery alongside its lithium-ion battery recycling efforts.

articles.title: Supreme Court sends furnace case back to appeals court
articles.summary: The top court agreed with the Trump administration that Biden-era rules effectively eliminating non-condensing gas furnaces and water heaters from the market are based on an incomplete legal review.

articles.title: Not-for-profit utilities turn to energy storage as data centers drive cost, reliability concerns
articles.summary: Reliability, power price hedging and avoided infrastructure investment are among the top reasons for the battery push, NRECA said.

articles.title: How load flexibility buys time for America’s data center boom
articles.summary: In markets where supply and demand are out of balance, grid connection increasingly comes with a choice: either bring the needed power yourself, or bring flexibility, write experts at ICF.

articles.title: FirstEnergy asks FERC to require data centers to pay for transmission interconnection costs
articles.summary: FirstEnergy’s proposal adopts a cost allocation practice from the gas pipeline sector. It comes ahead of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission’s expected large load interconnection decision on June 18.

articles.title: Škoda JS, Doosan Enerbility get key Rolls-Royce SMR work
articles.summary: Rolls-Royce SMR has selected Škoda JS and Doosan Enerbility for pre-production work for key components - including the reactor pressure vessel - for its small modular reactor programme.

articles.title: Russia and Kazakhstan sign nuclear power plant agreement
articles.summary: An intergovernmental agreement setting out the key principles - and export loan financing - for Kazakhstan's first nuclear power plant project has been signed during Russian President Vladimir Putin's state visit to the country.

articles.title: EDF highlights Hinkley Point C's positive impacts
articles.summary: EDF Energy has highlighted what it sees as the positive impact on people and the economy resulting from the Hinkley Point C nuclear power plant project in Somerset, England.

articles.title: Floating nuclear power plants 'realistic' for Greece
articles.summary: The report by the Deon Policy Institute think-tank identified no fundamental barriers to the implementation of floating nuclear power plants in Greece, although policy, regulatory, financial and social acceptance issues still need to be overcome.

articles.title: Decommissioning milestone reached at Trawsfynydd
articles.summary: Nuclear Restoration Services has announced the completion of a 20-year project to remove all the remaining intermediate-level radioactive waste from the shut-down Trawsfynydd nuclear power plant in Gwynedd, North Wales, UK.

articles.title: ITER magnet test facility begins operation
articles.summary: The ITER Organization has announced the start of operations at its Magnet Cold Test Facility following the successful cooldown of the first magnet coil to 4 Kelvin, or minus 269°C.

articles.title: Construction starts for Shin Hanul 4
articles.summary: First concrete has been poured for the reactor building of South Korea's Shin Hanul nuclear power plant's unit 4, marking the official start of construction.

articles.title: Energoatom gets operating licence for centralised fuel storage facility
articles.summary: The official licence for the operation of the Centralised Spent Nuclear Fuel Storage Facility has been handed over by the State Nuclear Regulatory Inspectorate of Ukraine to Energoatom.

articles.title: Nineteen years on, companies team up for US new-build project
articles.summary: Fulcrum Point Holdings and Blue Castle Holdings have formed a joint venture to take Blue Castle's project to build a nuclear power plant at Green River in Utah through the next stages of site development, licensing, and eventual reactor deployment, using Holtec International's SMR-300 small modular reactor technology.

articles.title: IAEA says turbine building damage 'consistent with impact of a drone'
articles.summary: "Attacks on nuclear sites are unacceptable and must stop in order to prevent the very real risk of a nuclear accident," International Atomic Energy Agency Director General Rafael Mariano Grossi has said following damage to a turbine building at Zaporizhzhia Nuclear Power Plant.

articles.title: In pictures: Second Hinkley Point C reactor vessel installed
articles.summary: The reactor pressure vessel has been installed for the second of the two EPR reactors at the Hinkley Point C nuclear power plant under construction in Somerset, England.

articles.title: Cameco, Orano take full ownership of Cigar Lake
articles.summary: Cameco and Orano have reached agreement to acquire Tepco's 5% participating interest in the Cigar Lake Joint Venture.

articles.title: Containment dome installed at Lianjiang 1
articles.summary: The outer dome of the double-layered containment building of unit 1 at the Lianjiang nuclear power plant in China's Guangdong province has been installed, China National Nuclear Corporation announced.

articles.title: ABS introduces shipping's first nuclear-ready notation
articles.summary: The American Bureau of Shipping announced the release of the ABS Nuclear-Ready Notation, an industry-first classification notation for marine and offshore assets designed to support future conversion to nuclear energy.

articles.title: Urenco to build new US enrichment plant capacity
articles.summary: Urenco has announced a multi-billion-dollar investment to provide a near-50% increase in enrichment capacity at Urenco USA's National Enrichment Facility, with construction beginning in 2029 and first production of low-enriched uranium in 2032.

articles.title: Fuel transfer work begins at Fukushima Daiichi unit 2
articles.summary: Tokyo Electric Power Company has announced the start of the removal of fuel assemblies from the used fuel storage pool of unit 2 at the damaged Fukushima Daiichi nuclear power plant in Japan.

articles.title: Milestones reached at Xudabao construction site
articles.summary: Hot functional tests have been completed at unit 3 of the Xudabao nuclear power plant in China's Liaoning Province ahead of the reactor's start up, while the reactor pressure vessel has been hoisted into place at unit 2.

articles.title: Argentina sees exports as a key nuclear policy objective
articles.summary: The four prioritised objectives for Argentina’s nuclear sector are "high value-added exports, energy security, preservation and development of national technological capacity, and regional leadership with geopolitical positioning".

articles.title: New York issues solicitations for nuclear new-build
articles.summary: The New York Power Authority has issued a call for nuclear developers and delivery partners for its initiative to develop at least 1 GW of advanced nuclear energy in Upstate New York, and an invitation to training providers to apply for USD40 million in nuclear workforce development funding.

articles.title: UK to cooperate with Singapore on nuclear regulation
articles.summary: The UK's Office for Nuclear Regulation has signed a memorandum of understanding with Singapore's National Environment Agency, formalising new cooperation on the regulation of civil nuclear energy.
